scope: Microsoft/Xbox brand family only, single selected catalog row (XXU-00015, Xbox Series S Carbon 1TB). No Samsung, no PlayStation, no Asus ROG Xbox Ally.
allowed_hosts_reason: Only host with any official-verification evidence on file for this brand family (source_research.v1.json, official_status=official_verified, source_role=support). No product-page-role domain is registered; none is added mid-run.
allowed_urls_reason: These are the 3 probe_targets already recorded in source_research.v1.json for the microsoft family; none is newly invented this stage.
mechanism: product_tool.census.probe.AccessProbe with ProbePolicy defaults (max_bytes=512000, min_interval=2s, timeout=10s), allowed_hosts restricted to the single host above. Redirect chains are validated per-hop against allowed_hosts; a redirect off-host aborts that request with access_status=REGIONAL_REDIRECT rather than following it.
stop_conditions: any 403 / 429 / confirmed challenge on support.microsoft.com (stops that host for the remainder of this run, per project AccessProbe behavior)
a redirect or discovered link points off the single allowed host (recorded as out-of-scope, not followed, does not itself burn a redirect-following request)
no further in-scope (same-host) candidate links remain after the support page and sitemap are read
explicit_non_goals: No brute-forcing of model codes or SKU patterns
No invented endpoints or guessed URLs
No widening beyond the single selected catalog row
